case_name: Smt. Preeti Manchanda Wife Of Shri ... vs Vishal Manchanda Son Of Shri Baldev ...
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties solemnized on 08.03.2011; applicant-wife filed application under Section 125 of Cr.P.C., complaint under Section 498A and 406 of IPC, and application for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act in Bundi.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Court has to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties.
legal_principles.held: Considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik (3 of 3) [CTA-6/2021] Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik (3 of 3) [CTA-6/2021] Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022

legal_principles.principle: The Court has to consider the social strata of both the parties.
legal_principles.held: Considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik (3 of 3) [CTA-6/2021] Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik (3 of 3) [CTA-6/2021] Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022

outcome.final_order: Transfer of Case No. 1047/2020 from Family Court No. 1 Jaipur to Family Court, Bundi.
